detail.longDescription: A made-up Facebook Marketplace sale: an oak desk at $180, with Muse handling the messages on "Always allow". This prompt builder counts 6 of the 7 steps running without asking the seller, and 4 of them cannot be undone. A $90 lowball accepted unasked: $180 - $90 = $90. That is $90 lost in a message that stays sent. # ChatGPT # Productivity https:// getreadystack.com/apps/muse-ai -prompts/?ref=ma_getreadys
